says: The single most-liked viewer comment in the whole niche lives here: a joke that demodex "are having demosex on my face every night" (59,782 likes), and viewers of that video joked in disbelief but were oddly comforted that the mites don't poop. Under the basal cell story, survivors shared their own melanoma and SCC stories and urged second opinions, while one asked why Mohs is needed for a basal cell; another commenter elsewhere wrote "It's almost seeming like a scam now with Mohs surgery." The rest are short and anxious: "Should I be worried doc", "should I be worried this is in my foot?", "What test catch this?"
